name: Retool
description_en:
Retool is a product in the Application development category. Its directory profile covers Web Development, Version Control, Testing Management, Software Development, Graphical User Interface, Mobile Development, Debugging, Collaboration.

Additional listed capabilities include Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $10.0. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: track changes to files and support revision workflows; organize test cases, execution and results; inspect program execution to investigate faults; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料还列出访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $10.0. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程；组织测试用例、执行过程与结果；检查程序执行过程以定位故障；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
